            text-transform: uppercase;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
        }

        .data-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
        }

        .data-table tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .data-table .value {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        .data-table .leader {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        .data-table .laggard {
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        /* Stat card */
        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-card .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem);
        }

        /* Bar chart (CSS-based) */
        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.75rem);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: min(80px, 12vw) 1fr min(50px, 8vw);
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .bar-track {
            height: clamp(20px, 3vh, 32px);
            background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }

            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0EA5E9, #22D3EE);
        }

        .bar-fill.wind {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10B981, #34D399);
        }

        .bar-fill.solar {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F59E0B, #FBBF24);
        }

        .bar-fill.other {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8B5CF6, #A78BFA);
        }

        .bar-value {
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        }

        /* Comparison layout */
        .comparison {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            align-items: center;
        }

        .comparison-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .comparison-item .comp-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .comparison-item .comp-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem);
        }

        .comparison-divider {
            width: 2px;
            height: min(80px, 10vh);
            background: var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 1px;
        }

        /* Key findings bullet list */
        .findings-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.75rem);
        }

        .findings-list li {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.75rem);

        .findings-list li .bullet-icon {

            width: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 22px);
            height: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 22px);

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .findings-list li strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .urgency-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .urgency-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .urgency-card .urgency-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 3.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .urgency-card .urgency-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* Call-to-action footer */
        .cta-footer {
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.1), rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.1));
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        /* Scale-in for stat values */
        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.85);
            transition: opacity 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* Slide from left for images */
        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-30px);
            transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        /* Bar chart animation: width starts at 0 */
        .bar-fill {
            width: 0;
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill {
            width: var(--bar-width);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-green));
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;

        /* ===========================================

           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);

        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.6);
        }
    </style>
</head>

         JAVASCRIPT: SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
         ============================================ -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            /* Intersection Observer: add .visible class when slides enter viewport */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* Keyboard navigation */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            /* Touch/swipe navigation */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                let startX = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diffY = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const diffX = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(diffY) > Math.abs(diffX) && Math.abs(diffY) > 50) {
                        if (diffY > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* Navigate to a specific slide */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            /* Progress bar */
            setupProgressBar() {
                const bar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                if (!bar) return;
                this.progressBar = bar;
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            /* Navigation dots */
            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot';
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
